data.readme: 1. 新增支持 Switch 2 主机。

1. 修复 Switch 模式异常断连问题。
2. 修复 Switch 模式下按组合键不能交换 A-B、X-Y 的问题。（Mode+Down / SELECT+Down / L+R+START）
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed abnormal disconnection on Switch mode.
2. Fixed the problem that A-B and X-Y can't be swapped by pressing the button combo on Switch mode. (Mode+Down / SELECT+Down / L+R+START)

data.readme: 1. 增加 Switch 模式的插线配对。
data.readme_en: 1. Added Support bluetooth pairing via USB  when it work on Switch mode.

data.readme:
1.按住手柄L+R+START 开机, 黄灯闪烁。
2.插入USB线连接PC。
3.点击USB 升级按钮然后选择升级文件升级。
data.readme_en:
1.Download the firmware file first from http://support.8bitdo.com/ 
2.Press and hold L1+R1+START buttons on the controller to put it on its update mode. LED on the top will blink in red.
3.Connect the controller to your Windows or macOS via the USB-C cable. 
4.Click on “USB Upgrade” on your device, search for bluetooth_firmware.dat in the pop-up window and run it;  
5.Un-plug the gamepad when the upgrade process is done, then restart it before using.
